title: NGOBase Funding Agencies Scraper
description: Collect public funding agency and grantmaker listings from NGOBase using agency name, country, state, or agency type filters.

keyword.title: Agency name keyword
keyword.description: Search funding agency names and public listing text.

country.title: Country
country.description: Country name or NGOBase country code. Used when no keyword is supplied.

state.title: State or province
state.description: Optional state or province name/code. A country is required when using this field.

agencyType.title: Agency type
agencyType.description: Funding agency type, such as Government Agency or UN Agency.

resultsWanted.title: Results wanted
resultsWanted.description: Maximum number of unique funding agency records to save.

maxPages.title: Maximum pages
maxPages.description: Maximum listing pages to request for the selected funding agency target.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional proxy settings. NGOBase is cleared by the Actor's stealth browser without a proxy by default. Apify Unblocker or residential proxies can be selected for extra reliability on aggressively challenged IPs.
